ticket.title: Add a --limit option ({run})
ticket.body:
Bench scenario S5 (throwaway).

## Spec

Add a `--limit N` option to the CLI that keeps the first N places of the search result. Expose it in `accessplaces/cli.py`. Add a unit test in `tests/test_cli.py`.

## Acceptance

- `python -m accessplaces cafe --limit 1` prints one place and the count line.
- Tests pass.
